pin_note: Byte-pinned copy of the refusal-vocabulary-pack crosswalk columns affidavit consumes: VALVE_CROSSWALK (6 strata-valve classes -> ash_a2a classes) and A2A_WIRE_CROSSWALK (transport-native atoms -> classes, designated wire code -32000), plus the declared ash_a2a class universe and affidavit's own RejectReason adjudication. Source of truth: packs/refusal-vocabulary-pack/ontology.ttl -> generated/crosswalk.rs (ggen sync run). Repair the sibling pack first, then re-pin here in the same dependency-closed transition; the drift court (tests/strata_refusal_crosswalk_seam.rs) fails on any other order.

valve_mappings.rationale: Wire shape wrong: unparsable/non-compliant frame header -> refused_structure (same class as erlmcp 1066/1021).
Declared fuel lease (a resource bound) exhausted -> refused_bounds (same class as erlmcp 1056/1068).
Parent digest cannot be re-anchored to the active register -> refused_receipt (receipt/replay anchoring failure, same family as erlmcp 1012).
Arena effect completed without its lawful 256-bit consequence receipt -> refused_consequence (same family as erlmcp 1049/1060).
Window capacity guard run.len > 8 (declared bound breached) -> refused_bounds.
Window capacity guard tau > 8 (declared bound breached) -> refused_bounds.

a2a_wire_mappings.rationale: Capacity outage on the A2A transport -> blocked_resource at the spec-reserved server-implementation code -32000 (transport/plug.ex wire_error/1).
Declared rate bound breached -> refused_bounds at the designated -32000 wire code.

wrong_profile.rationale: The profile tag did not equal PROFILE: a profile-law violation, same class family as unsupported_profile/refused_profile.

chain_hash_mismatch.rationale: Recomputed chain hash diverges from the stored one: receipt/replay anchoring failure, the same family as valve parent_discontinuity -> refused_receipt.

seq_not_contiguous.rationale: Event seq is not contiguous from 0: the payload's ordering shape is wrong, same class as valve malformed_frame -> refused_structure.

duplicate_event_id.rationale: Two events share an event_id: two identities that must be distinct collide — the verbatim refused_identity class description.

empty_event_type.rationale: Empty event_type field: payload shape wrong (missing field), same class as refused_structure.

zero_commitment.rationale: Commitment is the all-zero digest: an event recorded without its lawful 256-bit consequence commitment, same family as arena_failure -> refused_consequence.
